overview.about: The BMW Championship is the second event of the PGA Tour's FedExCup Playoffs, a no-cut tournament for the season's leading players that sets the field for the Tour Championship. Rotating around prestigious courses, it is one of the last chances to climb the standings before the finale.
overview.nextEvent: The next BMW Championship is played at a rotating host course, this edition at Bellerive Country Club near St. Louis. As the penultimate playoff event, only the top players qualify and every position affects seeding for the finale.
